definitions.explanation: A day when one doesn't work, a day off.

examples.japanese: {休日|きゅうじつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦しますか→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: What do you do on holidays?

examples.japanese: ⟦{今月|こんげつ}→今月：00720_kongetsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{休日出勤|きゅうじつしゅっきん}→休日出勤：noentry⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{二回|にかい}→二回：27625_nikai⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This month, I had to work on my day off twice.

examples.japanese: {休日|きゅうじつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しむ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。
{休日|きゅうじつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{過|す}ごす→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: I often spend my days off with my family.

examples.japanese: {休日|きゅうじつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|く}ると→来る：00254_kuru⟧、⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦{嫌|いや}→嫌：10232_iya⟧な⟦{気持|きも}ち→気持ち：01385_kimochi⟧になる。
examples.english: When work emails come on my day off, it makes me feel a bit annoyed.

notes:
{休日|きゅうじつ} is a general term for any day off from work or school. Composed of {休|きゅう} (rest) + {日|じつ} (day).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {休日|きゅうじつ}⟦{出勤|しゅっきん}→出勤：04548_shukkin⟧: working on a day off
- {休日|きゅうじつ}⟦{手当|てあて}→手当：04881_teate⟧: holiday pay/allowance
- {休日|きゅうじつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しむ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧: to enjoy one's day off
- {休日|きゅうじつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{過|す}ごす→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧: to spend a day off

CONTRAST:
- {休日|きゅうじつ}: day off (general — includes weekends and holidays)
- ⟦{祝日|しゅくじつ}→祝日：07588_shukujitsu⟧: national holiday (officially designated)
- ⟦{平日|へいじつ}→平日：03033_heijitsu⟧: weekday (opposite of {休日|きゅうじつ})
- ⟦{休暇|きゅうか}→休暇：02547_kyuuka⟧: vacation, leave (a period of days off, often planned)
- ⟦{定休日|ていきゅうび}→定休日：09541_teikyuubi⟧: regular closing day (for shops and restaurants)
